requirements.general_text: Any of these: A pass in STPM with a minimum of Grade C (GP 2.00) in any two (2) subjects A pass in STAM with a minimum grade of Jayyid A pass in Matriculation or Foundation with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 A Diploma (Level 4, MQF) with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 Pass DKM/DLKM/DVM (HEP is required to implement a screening and bridging program which correspond to the program field); AND Pass an interview OR submission of portfolio determined by the HEP as required. English Requirements for Internatinal Students Malaysian University English Test (MUET) with Band 3 OR its equivalent.
